knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson records that the Victorian licence page indicates scissor lifts do not need the WP licence, and that other states are not confirmed. Operator competency duties still apply.

practicalCriteria: Assessor asks the candidate to state the scissor lift licence position for one named state, with the source status
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate. Completing the add-on grants no licence.
evidenceRequired: Assessor note on any licence or authority claim made by the candidate
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate states a scissor lift licence rule for a state with no confirmed source
